title: Disable OnboardingWalkthrough dialog
body:
The "Welcome to ObjectUI" onboarding walkthrough dialog has been disabled.

## Changes

- **`OnboardingWalkthrough.tsx`** — replaced full dialog implementation with a null-returning stub; comment documents the decision and points to git history for restoration
- **`Onboarding.test.tsx`** — stripped down to a single assertion that the component renders nothing
